about.title: How MyVoice works

why.title: Your opinion becomes part of the bigger picture
why.body: MyVoice brings community opinions together through clear votes. You choose one of two options, and your participation stays in your history.
why.note: Voting, tasks, and useful activity earn VOX.

how.title: Read the question, choose an option, see the final result
how.body: You can review the description and sources before choosing. Live numbers stay hidden so other votes do not influence you. The result appears after closing.
how.note: One account can cast one final, unchangeable vote.

future.title: Collective decisions can reveal what people care about
future.body: In the future, popular decisions may inspire initiatives and projects. New mechanics will launch step by step after technical and legal review.
future.note: This screen presents a direction, not a promise of a specific project.
